parameters.atmosphere: 1% SF6 and 99% CO2 melting protective gas

evidence.quote: The Mg-9Gd-3Nd-1Zn-1Sn-0.5Zr (wt%) alloy was prepared in the 1% SF6 and 99% CO2 melting protective gas protection. It should be noted that the temperature of the whole smelting process was between 720 °C and 780 °C.
cylindrical samples (U15 mm x 10 mm) were cut for compression in a Gleeble-3500 thermal simulator from the homogenized alloy (treated at 525 °C for 10 h)

the heating temperatures were varied from 300 °C to 450 °C with an interval of 50 °C at a rate of 0.001 s-1 to 1 s-1. When the sample was compressed to a true strain of 0.8, the test was stopped and it was cooled by water quenching.
the experiments were carried out with the punching speed of 2 mm/s, the temperatures of 400 °C, 425 °C and 450 °C and the extrusion ratio of 12.

evidence.section: 3.1 Microstructure analysis of as-cast and solid-solution alloys
evidence.quote: These eutectic phases are composed of some sphere Mg5(RE, Zn) phases with a diameter of about 5 um, some square Mg5(RE, Zn) phase with a side length of about 2 um

evidence.section: 3.1 Microstructure analysis of as-cast and solid-solution alloys
evidence.quote: and some Mg2(Sn, Nd)3Gd2 particles.

attributes.morphology: continuous network at grain boundaries; coarser at trigeminal junctions

evidence.section: 3.1 Microstructure analysis of as-cast and solid-solution alloys
evidence.quote: the Mg5(RE, Zn) at the grain boundary is slightly connected into a continuous network.

evidence.section: 3.1 Microstructure analysis of as-cast and solid-solution alloys
evidence.quote: only few undissolved Mg2(Sn, Nd)3Gd2 phases exist in its intragranular region

attributes.morphology: equiaxed dendritic with relatively bimodal grain size distribution

evidence.section: 3.1 Microstructure analysis of as-cast and solid-solution alloys
evidence.quote: composition of the alloy mainly consists of equiaxed dendrites and eutectic compounds. The result shows that the grain size distribution is the relative bimodal with an average grain size of about 31 um.

evidence.section: 3.1 Microstructure analysis of as-cast and solid-solution alloys
evidence.quote: many eutectic compounds are distributed in a continuous network along grain boundaries
As the deformation resistance is smaller at 0.001 s-1, there is no dynamic recrystallization and the grains are still large. The grains are coarse

attributes.location: grain boundary and trigeminal grain boundaries

evidence.quote: small recrystallized crystal grains surround large crushed grains... Only a small amount of extremely fine recrystallized grains appear at the grain boundaries
When the alloy is extruded at 400 °C, there is a large tear crack at the surface of the bars, and the fracture does not show obvious oxidation.
there are dislocation pile-up groups in the grains (Fig. 5a), which are caused by the small strain rate and the low recovery.
As the strain rate increases to 0.1, dislocation entanglement gradually disappears and substructure becomes clear. Besides, sub-grain boundary is obvious to be detected

evidence.section: 4 Microstructure analysis of compressed alloy and its constitutive relation
evidence.quote: the deformation activation energy Q = 174.432 kJ/mol of Mg-9Gd-3Nd-1Zn-1Sn-0.5Zr alloy can be obtained.
the deformation activation energy is calculated to be 174.456 kJ/mol.

evidence.section: 4 Microstructure analysis of compressed alloy and its constitutive relation
evidence.quote: the peak stress increases monotonously with decreasing temperature, indicating that work hardening is dominant at low temperatures.
the microstructure of the alloy is mainly dynamic recovery at low strain rates, while the formation of dynamic recrystallization grains is promoted at high strain rate.
the formation of dynamic recrystallization grains is promoted at high strain rate.

evidence.section: 4 Microstructure analysis of compressed alloy and its constitutive relation
evidence.quote: the peak stress increases with the increasing strain rate, which indicates that dislocation accumulation and weakening of the work hardening are more obvious at the relatively low strain rate.
